potential: V=-mu² sum|h|² + lambda(sum|h|²)² + delta sum|h_k|^4, mu²=lambda=1
analytic_minimization: At fixed R=sum|h|², sum|h|^4 lies between R²/6 and R². For delta>0, global minimum has six equal nonzero magnitudes and V=-mu^4/[4(lambda+delta/6)]; for delta<0 and lambda+delta>0, minimum is a single active Higgs mode and V=-mu^4/[4(lambda+delta)]. ALL complex Higgs phases drop out from V; CP is not predicted by this potential.
one_torus_D_flat_obstruction: With only a single positive-area T² and no charged scalar compensating D terms, line bundles of fluxes 0,3,6 have unequal slopes, so cannot all obey a common equal-slope SUSY D-flat condition. Additional T² fluxes, compensating fields or different gauge bundle data are required.
global_consistency_missing: complete 10D gauge group and chiral spectrum
Kahler metrics for ALL charged fields
Higgs potential generated by actual action
boundary: This is an exact result for an intentionally MINIMAL assumed Higgs potential and toy normalized one-torus overlap tensor, not a first-principles SM compactification. Complex VEVs are tunable; nonzero CP invariant does not prove dynamical CP breaking.
